android_mechanism: Browser search suggestions materialize all matching history rows eagerly
bug_description: On application startup the main page eagerly queries every per-day history table in the RDB database and materializes all browsing-history rows in memory (Index.aboutToAppear -> RdbUtils.queryAllDate + queryHistoriesByDate for each date), even though history is only consumed when the user opens the browsing-history dialog. Cold-start latency and startup CPU grow linearly with the number of recorded history entries.
fix_summary: History is loaded lazily on first open of the history dialog (PagesDialog.loadHistoryData), and RdbUtils.queryHistoriesByDate now actually awaits the RDB query instead of returning an unfilled array.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: startup window: 4.86G vs 1.51G instructions (3.2x); cpu 2122 vs 747 ms

mechanism_oracle.definition: CPU time of the app process across the case window, from trace.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed_startup_cpu_time_ms > fixed_startup_cpu_time_ms by >= 20% with 30+ seeded history entries; fixed shows zero history-table SELECT queries during startup, unfixed shows N (one per day table).
mechanism_oracle.auxiliary: hilog marker '项目已启动' timestamp delta from process start.

reproduction: git -C hosts/browser checkout case/browser_eager_history_load/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/browser checkout case/browser_eager_history_load/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
